# HandSelect

Two keybinds, "Swap to left hand" and "Swap to right hand" (Controls > Basic interaction, unbound by default, as in
SS13). Each makes the first hand on that side active, rather than cycling the way Swap hands does. It does nothing if
the player has no hand on that side or can't interact.

Entry point: `WFHandSelectSystem`, a shared system, so the change is predicted. It binds `WFHandSelectKeys`, which
marked edits add to the human input context in `ContentContexts` and to the Controls tab.
